cookiecutter.package_title: API Wrapper to the FRED and ALFRED Federal Reserve Economic Data API
cookiecutter.description: R API wrapper to the St. Louis Fed's FRED and ALFRED economic-data API supporting both synchronous and asynchronous (promise based) operations. Provides an R6 client for series observations, as-known-then ALFRED vintages (paged for large matrices), series metadata, search, and releases, built on the shared connectcore transport base with a vintage-first, point-in-time-honest discipline.
